infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RimSocial uses the camera so you can take photos and videos to post and send.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RimSocial uses the microphone to record sound with your videos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RimSocial lets you choose photos and videos from your library to post and send.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: RimSocial saves photos and videos you choose to your library.
